title: begin counts any earlier working event of the item as the new worker's, so after a re-dispatch the printed wait returns on the new worker's own working event
goal: begin takes the newest coord sequence before it starts the worker and holds only for a working event posted after it, so the wait it prints skips the new worker's own working event after a re-dispatch

run:
import json,os,re,shlex,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
mode=sys.argv[1]                       # "dispatch" (gap 2) or "begin-old-working" (gap 1)
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");COORD=os.path.abspath("_tools/coord.py")
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());rem=d/"remote.git"
s.run(["git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",str(rem)],check=True);r=d/"clone"
s.run(["git","clone","-q",str(rem),str(r)],check=True,capture_output=True)
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch","worktree_dir":"wt","land_push":["git","push","origin","HEAD:main"]}))
(r/"items").mkdir();(r/".gitignore").write_text("_cache/\nwt/\n");(r/"x.txt").write_text("x")
(r/"items"/"SP-cccccccc.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-cccccccc","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"active","goal":"g"}))
(r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(id="ST-aaaaaaaa",kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",sprint="SP-cccccccc",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]),indent=2)+"\n")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main");g("fetch","-q","origin")
b=d/"bin";b.mkdir();(b/"claude").write_text("#!/bin/sh\ncat >/dev/null\nsleep 12\necho '{\"subtype\":\"success\",\"num_turns\":1,\"total_cost_usd\":0,\"session_id\":\"s1\",\"result\":\"done\"}'\n");os.chmod(b/"claude",0o755)
env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=str(d/"coord.sqlite"),CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk",PATH=str(b)+os.pathsep+os.environ["PATH"],GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="x",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="x@x",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="x",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="x@x")
bl=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
if mode=="dispatch":
    bl("claim","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","claude-chk","--commit");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main")
    p=bl("dispatch","ST-aaaaaaaa","--detach")
else:                                   # an earlier dispatch of the item left a working event
    s.run([sys.executable,COORD,"post","--kind","progress","--field","item=ST-aaaaaaaa","--field","state=working"],env=env,check=True,capture_output=True)
    p=bl("begin","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","claude-chk")
m=re.search(r"coord\.py (wait [^`]*--pid (\d+))`",p.stdout)
argv=[sys.executable,COORD]+shlex.split(m.group(1));argv[argv.index("--timeout")+1]="20"
w=s.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=60)
try:os.killpg(int(m.group(2)),15)
except OSError:pass
out=json.loads(w.stdout);shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True)
states=[e["fields"].get("state") for e in out["events"]]
print("printed since:",argv[argv.index("--since")+1],"events:",states,"timed_out:",out["timed_out"])
sys.exit(1 if "working" in states else 0)   # the wait must not return on the worker's own working event
